fusions.name: Flattener
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy blunt slug that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: Fires into the ground at your feet, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring armour and leaving them 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cocked Back
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Flat Impact
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
